notes.title: "Blade of the Netherworld" V1.0 version is now officially launched!
notes.content:
Dear Netherworld rangers,
We are excited to announce that the official version V1.0 of Blade of the Netherworld is now officially launched! In this action game full of adventure and combat, players will embark on a yin and yang intertwined killing journey. The official version is still priced at 29 yuan, with a 10% discount in the first week, and the official version can directly integrate the archives of the EA version!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/bef38866d2989288d6bde001bbdcdd0c0ba18571.png[/img]
"Blade of the Netherworld" is an action pigeon game published by Hurricane Games and developed by Dudu Games. The retro pixel visual style of the game is unique. 
In the game, players will wear divine masks and become yin and yang officials, traveling through the Netherworld to kill gods, demons and ghosts. Combine nearly a hundred props in the game to hone your combat skills and freely combine combos. Experience unlimited freedom of high-speed killing in a completely liberated action system. When you are tired of cutting, you can still plant a field. The journey is full of surprises and challenges.
Join us now and embark on this epic adventure in the Netherworld! For more details and to purchase the game, visit the Game Store page[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2369950/_/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2369950/_/[/url]

[h2]Highlights of the official version[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b] Smooth and smooth combat: [/b] "Blade of the Netherworld" adopts a smooth-action combat system. In the almost completely liberated action system, you can freely combine and follow the action, and travel among the enemies at high speed. The experience is endless. Restricted freedom of high-speed killing and ultimate swordsmanship and combat fun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/6371a0db8dd5b3e17f4b2d036b0cc6edf71edace.png[/img]
[*] [b] New mode Trial Land: [/b] This is a new mode we have added. Players will be affected by random factors during the challenges on each floor of the Trial Land, which will give you The battle has a big impact, and we will continue to enrich the gameplay of this mode in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/257d8e2fba221e52b4306fd73faa8d90c5706648.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]More and more comprehensive upgrades:[/b]The official version brings comprehensive game content upgrades and optimizations, including more mob types, more prop types, more mental techniques, and A new final BOSS and a new game mode!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/2a5f00f5a30a5876a65014ca320e66ce1a379fcf.png[/img]
[*] [b]New talent system:[/b] We have completely redesigned the talent system in the game, and at the same time, we have made more balanced numerical adjustments, so that players will get a better gaming experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/d09b72b6254c54418b42cdc79bcf557ec5abbceb.png[/img]
[/list]
Thank you for your attention and support! Let us write a legend together in the  "Blade of the Netherworld"!

notes.title: Spring Festival event has started！
notes.content:
Hello, players and friends

We are the team of "Black and White Blade" for DuDu Games. As the Spring Festival approaches, we would like to extend a New Year greeting to everyone and wish them all the best in the Dragon Year.

Also, I have some good news to share with everyone. On February 4th, our game was launched on Taptap Indie Spotlight, which was a double blessing for us. Therefore, we will launch the first discount for Black and White Blade on February 5th, with a discount of -10%. The original price is 29 yuan, and the discount is 26.1 yuan after that; The event will last for 7 days.

In addition, the Spring Festival activities will also come in this update. If our game can bring you a little New Year flavor during this holiday, it would also be our honor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/94e556bc1b22544c6d96a3b15eae2af09048e667.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Peach Blossom Spring Festival decoration updated, adding Dragon Year mask[/b][/h2]

The residents of the underworld will also celebrate the arrival of the Spring Festival with us, and red lanterns will be hung in the small houses and peach blossom gardens.

In addition to the decoration updates, we have also added masks limited to the Year of the Dragon. In battles, monsters will randomly drop unique elements of the Spring Festival, which can be used to synthesize Dragon Year masks, allowing this red dragon to accompany you through this New Year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/2029ac8c49e3220c8c64812e9bb8f5214a71ebc9.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Add 9 secondary weapons and more attack combos and tricks[/b][/h2]

The secondary weapon has always been a part that we want to strengthen. So after this period of explosive liver, we have updated 9 new secondary weapons, namely Crossbow Device, Thunderbolt, Yin Weapon Summoning, Sword Spirit Exercise, Demon Cat Contract, Tracking Arrow, Poison Arrow, Burning Bottle, and Spinning Blade.

In addition to adding secondary weapons, we have also added entries related to long-range projectiles in the Blessing section. We hope that these new secondary weapons and blessing entries can bring you a different gaming experience. If you want more secondary weapons with different styles and effects, you can leave a message or tell us through QQ groups.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/83b1e40b66fdf2ff1cd91956d392fc0a86088458.jpg[/img]
[b] [h2] More Mind Techniques and Gameplay [/h2] [/b]

In addition to increasing the number of secondary weapons, we also added 8 mental techniques. These mental techniques are unyielding willpower, Phoenix Feather Crystal, Super Chef, Zerg artifacts, Vajra Immortal, Free Body Technique, Iron Legs Floating on Water, and Shura Mind.

Enriching gameplay and game content is also one of our current goals, and these mental skills are just a small part of what we hope to achieve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/3205b649643e0c3c45bbf42f0b444e09573285bd.jpg[/img]
[b] [h2] A brand new divine mask appears: Hou Yi, Day and Night Wandering God [/h2] [/b]

In addition to the limited masks for the Year of the Dragon, we have also added two divine masks, Houyi and Daynight Wandering God.

Regarding the Divine Mask, some friends have previously reported to us that there is often a situation where a large number of fragments on the same side are brushed, but there is no mask on the other side. In the new version update, we have adjusted the probability of fragments falling on the left and right sides, hoping that this can help everyone get these new masks faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/93b131896e74b5b55480da8fb1a848a665c76d0d.jpg[/img]
The above is the main content of this update. Finally, I wish everyone a happy new year, family reunion, and good luck. In the upcoming Year of the Dragon, we will continue to keep updating according to our promise and never run away!

notes.title: Blade of the Netherworld: EA Launches December 4th!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
Blade of the Netherworld is set to launch on Steam EA on December 4th. It was previously scheduled for December 1st, but in the player test, you found many unintended bugs, so we need a few days to optimize and improve the current version of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/b43bfc39241cb2f4cd3d1062e9c0726dd21b7e02.png[/img]

Now join the Discord can also participate in the final test before the launch, and have the opportunity to get the activation code of the game, EA will also open a mysterious player event on the day of the launch, I hope you can pay more attention to our progress!
Discord  https://discord.gg/maCEnUAej2
From Demo to EA, we held the first speedrun competition, and the Blade of the Netherworld also participated in the Shanghai Weplay Show and was nominated for "Best Mobile Game"; The most important thing is that I have met a lot of player friends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/66e6e83f296b32e3512e33d559e74b61a18b8a2a.png[/img]

Everyone gave us a lot of suggestions and contributed hundreds bug feedback records. In order to thank these players who have always supported us, we have added the best and most active players in the speedrunning competition to the game in the form of easter eggs, and we will also make the lucky players in the form of easter eggs in future player activities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/e93c4fcce2ff6f58b8f422fec5f63cf3e9ec5925.png[/img]

At this stage, the focus of our work is to increase the game build . We've added a new way to play with elemental interactions, and the two elements will have different associations with each other.       
In addition, we have added new items, such as the split stream, which can split the player's projectiles, and some martial arts-enhancing items, which can be combined to build a ranged combat build.
In future updates, we will add more element interactions and props, and as for the effect of the linkage between them, we will leave it to you to explore for yourself.
As we said before, we've updated the fishing gameplay, added multiple mini-bosses, and strengthened the Divine Mask, and these updates will continue to increase after EA goes live.

In our understanding, EA is more like a promise with you all, and we hope to present our ideas and efforts to all players, so we will continue to update the game until it is officially launched.
On the day of the EA release, we will also officially announce the update plan of the game from EA to the official launch, thank you for your supervision! See you at EA!

notes.title: "Blade of the Netherworld" scheduled to be launched on December 1st
notes.content:
Hi, everyone.

I would like to share with you an important news today that is, "Blade of the Netherworld" is officially scheduled to be released on December 1st! The game will be launched on Steam EA, and compared with the Demo version and the early versions of the game, it has also made great updates and changes. I hope this update can be enough to satisfy you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/aa25d514316335b75e70125104553c6300734a8b.png[/img]

At the same time, we are also very grateful to the players who participated in speedrun competition. Thank you very much for your participation. We will also post your participation videos on the homepage of Bilibili later.

Thank you very much to the fans and players who have supported us all the way and made suggestions on the game. If you are interested in the game or have any feedback on the game content, you can join our Discord at any time, and player activities will be organized from time to time in the community.

Discord: https://discord.gg/maCEnUAej2

Well, the following is the update from the Demo version to the EA version, that is, what you can actually play in the EA version


[b]Fishing in the Hall of Yama[/b]
First of all, I don't know why all players like the update of farming methods.
In fact, when designing this part of the content at the beginning, I really didn't expect that so many players would like it, and in the process of testing and collecting Demo feedback, we also saw a lot of suggestions about farming. Finally, we decided to update the fishing mini-games first.
The updated fishing game will not make players click the space all the time. Now you need to press or release the space at the right time until the fish falls out of the water. We hope that this update will give you a closer fishing experience in life, and even get a pole in the Hall of Yama.
If you think this small change is not bad, we will then optimize the gameplay of knocking wooden fish or stir-frying, which may make the wooden fish closer to the audio game experience, or add elements to control the heat to the cooking gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/5dfba899131d8f1dd8df8aa3d33ef4cdc8be11c7.gif[/img]

[b]A lot of Secondary Bosses! Never most, only more![/b]
Maybe you have played Hammer and Tauren many times in the Demo version, so you will get a richer BOSS battle experience in the upcoming EA version. From October 1 to today, we will keep updating the frequency of a small boss every week. Rate, 5 small bosses have been updated,hundred-legged rot worm, six-handed Yama, wasp monster, big toad and big horse monkey (the last three names have not been determined).
More secondary Bosses will be added in the EA version, and the skills of some previous old bosses will also be adjusted.
The following is a demonstration of the battle screen of these bosses, which are still under functional development.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/c66f08798acf21e894474b014ec560c0a32090f4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/06f992fc0e2169eb5edda926d80b83a321617577.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/2ab936f835d71dc94b895375cee743af7b2783a8.gif[/img]

[b]The Divine Mask will also be strengthened![/b]
In fact, from the test to today, some players have been feedback that the Divine Mask is not strong enough, so we have also tried to strengthen the Black Imitator Mask. The current Black Imitator Mask will not only emit a ray, but also emit 8 rays in different directions, and it will fold back to your side 
If you're happy with this change, we'll be making improvements to other masks in different ways in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/4ce7e01bb9277000080b30d247957744294a0150.gif[/img]

[b]After EA, our update plan - Build update, monster update, BOSS renovation and new mode![/b]
In fact, there are still many problems in the game that we need to constantly optimize and solve. For example, we are not particularly satisfied with the props and builds of the game at present, so in later versions, we will update the game's build system, so that players can build more interesting genre.
In the future, we will also add more monsters to the game to create a more diverse combat experience. In addition, we also plan to update the multi-week elements of the game to bring a richer experience to players who embark on every killing journey, and we are currently considering adding a new mode, specifically We are still in a heated internal discussion, and I believe that a detailed update plan will be presented to all players soon.

notes.content:
Hi,everyone

Then there's this week's update announcement, which focused on optimizing how to get Divine Masks in the game. Know that the Divine Masks is a very important part of the game, different masks have their own abilities, and you can only use different types of weapons if you wear the Divine Masks, and its importance is even reflected in the title.

But based on  feedback, we found that most players don't actually collect Divine Masks, which means that you can complete most of the game with just one sword, which is great, I mean it. But also missed a big types of weapons and item skills, which is a shame.
Many players have reported that they have no idea that they can craft this mask, or even that they have obtained the mask fragment, so we decided to let players know in a more conspicuous way that you have obtained the mask - how about defeating a secondary boss?

notes.title: September Update#2:
notes.content:
Hi everyone

Another week has passed. We mainly updated two bosses last week, namely, the spider boss that players saw for the first time, and the final boss. Because in the last test, many players reported that the design of the BOSS battle was not good enough. So we're going to start updating BOSS this week and for some time to come.
The updated content of the first Spider BOSS will also be directly installed in the demo version released in the Steam Next Fest in October. At that time, all players can experience it. notes.title: Blade of the Netherworld Update Announcement #1
notes.content:
Hi guys

We conducted a round of small-scale player testing a week ago and received feedback from all players who participated in the testing. We are very grateful to all enthusiastic players. Your opinions on game are helpful to us. 
We will adjust the version plan based on the test feedback collected here. Thank you again for your feedback. According to the results of this test, we decided to add a gallery function, and also adjusted the way to obtain the Divine mask. Hope to help you Get a better gaming experience.

At the same time, we also have good news to announce. "Blade of the Netherworld" will participate in Steam's New Product Festival in October. At that time, we will launch a demo version of the game. We hope that all players can pay more attention to our Game, click to add to wishlist.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2369950/_/]>>>Store Page<<<[/url]

[h3]gallery function optimization[/h3]
In the gallery, you can browse the collected props and encounter information about enemies, as well as BOSSes and weapons. Of course, this function is not perfect yet, so we will continue to adjust and optimize the illustrated book function.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/a2e93c07e901b1c790efee7753708a2d4b887093.jpg[/img]
[h3]Adjustment of how to obtain the Divine Mask[/h3]
Secondly, we have also adjusted the way to obtain the Divine Mask. We plan to add some mini-BOSS to the game, which will bring a completely different combat experience from regular enemies. After defeating them, you can obtain the mask core and refine the corresponding godhead mask.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/5ccc9eb0a0a591aca6243105cb5b155c75820321.jpg[/img]

[h3]Optimization of the mind method selection interface[/h3]
Finally, we have also optimized the Xinfa interface and the mask selection interface. The current Xinfa interface and Divine mask selection interface are more intuitive to satisfy everyone's collection addiction (who would refuse the joy of filling the entire room with collections).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/c8777e8569448051c3abdcf3a4c4158da808175a.jpg[/img]
In fact, these newly added functions are not all of our updates. We spend a lot of time on adaptation work. This is the first time we adapt a game, so the process is bumpy, but fortunately everything is going well. Development in a good direction, in the future we will add the function of button setting to further optimize the game experience of players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/6889296e89d229f0a964f7499c82bb4b05782be7.gif[/img]
[h3]About collecting feedback[/h3]
All feedback about the game, whether positive or negative, is very helpful and important to us. We are really grateful to every player who gave feedback in Q group, Steam, feedback list and offline. Thank you for organizing your thoughts and communicating with us.
For a small independent game studio like ours, it is really important and meaningful to collect player feedback and communicate with players. For us, we hope that you can continue to give feedback, and we will continue to release updates in the future.
I hope more players can give positive feedback, thank you very much! (The accompanying picture is a live picture of an offline trial play, thank you players for coming from afar)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863641/63742cc0c223da135660b3896f121fa64f10396c.png[/img]
Having said so much, here is the complete update content of this September 1st update. The version that is too long to read is: better adaptation, new functions and experience optimization.
[h3]Game optimization[/h3]
-Added the first version of the illustrated book function to facilitate players to browse collected items and encounter information on enemies
-Optimized the game's adaptation so that it can adapt to more player configurations
-Optimized the way to obtain masks, and added 3 mini-BOSS accordingly
-Optimized the interface of mental method selection and mask selection
-Optimized the BOSS battle system

[h3]Fix BUG[/h3]
-Fixed various BUGs caused by adaptation in the game
-Fixed game functions that may cause the game to become stuck and unable to move during booting
-Fixed the bug that caused the game to get stuck after returning to various pages. Now you can enter and exit these pages normally.
-Fixed several minor bugs that may cause the game experience to be unsmooth

notes.title: "Blade of the Netherworld" will soon participate in the Guangzhou Fusion Exhibi
notes.content:
Game Features:

Divine Masks: Different divine masks alter the combat style, such as sword, fist, whip, and more.
Random Items: Freely combine item effects for a unique experience in every battle.
Off-hand Weapons: Utilize various characteristics of off-hand weapons to defeat enemies.
Hidden Storylines or Rooms: Explore hidden rooms, storylines, and easter eggs within the game's environments.
Simulated Management: Engage in activities like farming, fishing, cooking, and selling food.
